name: scroll-focus-list
title: Scroll focus list
description: A list where the item at the reading line is at full strength and the rest step back, for steps, features and long lists, always at readable contrast.
docs: It watches a thin band at lineAt (0.45 by default) with an IntersectionObserver, in the nearest scrolling box or the page, so there is no scroll listener. The row at the line gets aria-current and data-active; render lets you draw your own rows and read that state. Other rows step back only as far as your muted-foreground, never lighter, so contrast stays at AA, and the description of the current row steps up toward your foreground; dim sets how far. Space the rows with the --rhs-focus-gap variable, and leave room above the first and below the last so each can reach the line. Under reduced motion the other rows are not dimmed, and without JavaScript nothing is.
